== Biography ==
John Glasgow was born about 1768. He was the son of [[Glasgow-1218|David Glasgow]] and [[Glasgow-1219|Janet Glasgow]].<ref>Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950. MyHeritage.com [online database], accessed 2025. https://www.myheritage.com/research/record-30226-5947402/john-glasgow-in-scotland-births-baptisms.</ref> He was christened on 12 June 1768 in Kelso, Roxburghshire, Scotland.<ref>Scotland, Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950. MyHeritage.com [online database], accessed 2025. https://www.myheritage.com/research/record-30226-5947402/john-glasgow-in-scotland-births-baptisms.</ref>

John appears in the admission records of 8 October 1779 to a medical institution in Kelso, recommended by Mr. Charleton, at age 10, with a tumor on his face. He was cured by 17 October 1779.<ref>National Records of Scotland, NRS Reference HH71/7 p. 19.</ref>
